Mission Local reported that District Attorney Brooke Jenkins was placed in a State Bar diversionary program over ethics complaints after she accessed a confidential rap sheet for an unrelated case and emailed it to a colleague who also had no connection to the case. The story said the State Bar dismissed the other complaints and acted on the records incident.
